newsitem.title: UK: Electronic trade format for ship supplies due Sept.
newsitem.headline: Electronic trade format for ship supplies due Sept.

text.p: An electronic trading standard format for marine supplies purchasing will be available by September, a maritime trading association said on Tuesday.

The International Marine Purchasing Association (IMPA) said it has been working over recent months to create an electronic trading format based on UN electronic data interchange (EDIFACT) standards but tailored to the specific requirements of the marine industry.
IMPA spokesman Stephen Kitchen said: "The standard will be ready by June 3. It will be available by September after further testing."

He said the standard would increase the potential for shipping companies to do business using electronic data interchange (EDI) plus cut costs and improve speed and accuracy involved in documentation.
IMPA has 300 members from over 40 countries, including some of the world's major ship-owning, managing, operating and supplying companies.
